title: Disney Adventure
description: Cruise ship operated by Disney Cruise Line
extract: Disney Adventure is a cruise ship owned and operated by Disney Cruise Line, a subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company. She is the eighth ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet and the first and only current vessel of the Global class, with her originally planned sister ship canceled. At 208,108 gross tonnage (GT), Disney Adventure is one of the largest cruise ships in the world and the largest cruise ship ever built in Germany. She is also the first four-funnelled ocean-going passenger vessel since the retirement of the RMS Aquitania in 1950.
